break_cases.case: optimistic: factor-model standalone, half MRVL discount reverses
base: blended standalone (geometric midpoint), half reversal
stress: AAOI-like standalone, full MRVL reversal
regulatory failure: stress standalone + after-tax fee, full reversal

bottom_up.component: Marvell stockholders approve share issuance + charter amendment
bottom_up.rationale: Votes-cast standard (low bar) and both boards unanimous, but MRVL fell ~20% abnormally on the news and holders cite dilution (33% to LITE holders). No organised opposition or proxy-adviser view found as of 2026-11-24.

Majority-of-OUTSTANDING standard (abstentions count as no). The offer is now worth less than LITE's pre-talks price and below factor-model standalone estimates; CEO says shareholders are 'not happy'. Votes expected after the S-4 is effective (mid-2027, assumption).

bottom_up.component: Required regulatory approvals (HSR, China SAMR, others) before the final outside date
bottom_up.rationale: Commentators (Breakingviews, Bloomberg Intelligence) name SAMR as the key risk. SAMR cleared Marvell-Cavium, Marvell-Inphi, AMD-Xilinx, II-VI-Coherent and Lumentum-NeoPhotonics (several with long delays/conditions), but let Qualcomm-NXP, Applied-Kokusai and Intel-Tower lapse. Remedies are capped at 'material to the combined company' (Burdensome Condition), so Marvell can walk from heavy remedies (paying USD 3.2bn).

bottom_up.component: No other termination (MAE, superior proposal, renegotiation failure, litigation)
bottom_up.rationale: Standard MAE carve-outs exclude industry-wide and stock-price changes; reciprocal no-shops and large fees.
